SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE defensive_work_rate = 'low' AND overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 65
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.penalties DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT T2.team_short_name FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.team_api_id = T1.away_team_api_id INNER JOIN League AS T3 ON T3.id = T1.league_id WHERE T3.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND T1.season = '2009/2010' AND T1.away_team_goal > T1.home_team_goal GROUP BY T2.team_short_name ORDER BY COUNT(T2.team_short_name) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed FROM Team_Attributes ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT T1.team_long_name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND T2.date BETWEEN '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2014-01-31 00:00:00' AND T2.chanceCreationPassing < ( SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) FROM Team_Attributes ) ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC
SELECT COUNT(player_api_id) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1990'
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND strftime('%Y', T1.date) = '2009' AND strftime('%m', T1.date) = '04'
SELECT T2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND T2.date = '2012-02-22 00:00:00'
SELECT T2.defenceAggressionClass FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND T2.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00'
SELECT T2.finishing, T2.curve FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T1.weight DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.`First Date`, strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`T-BIL` > 2.0
SELECT CASE WHEN `T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'Abnormal' END FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464 AND Date = '1995-09-04'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' AND T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
SELECT T2.Description, T2.Diagnosis FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 48473
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE TP < 6 OR TP > 8.5
SELECT AVG(T2.UA) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA < 8.0) OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA < 6.5)
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG > 200 AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 50
SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991' AND T2.GLU < 180

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0 AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T3.IGG BETWEEN 900 AND 2000 AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Description IS NULL AND (T2.CRP LIKE '+' OR T2.CRP LIKE '-' OR T2.CRP < 1.0)
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 18 AND T2.CRP > 1.0
SELECT T2.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) >= '1995' AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '+' AND T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('-', '+-') ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01' AND T1.SC170 IN ('-', '+-')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.SSB IN ('-', '0')
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.SEX = 'M'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GOT >= 60
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GOT < 60
SELECT T2.`Examination Date` FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 ORDER BY T1.ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP > 6.0 AND T2.TP < 8.5
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`ANA Pattern` = 'P' AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250
SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.department = 'Art and Design Department'
SELECT COUNT(T2.event_id) FROM attendance AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.type = 'Meeting' GROUP BY T2.event_id HAVING COUNT(T1.link_to_member) > 10
SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.major_name = 'Human Development and Family Studies' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Large'
SELECT T2.expense_description FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN major_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN major_name = 'Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM major
SELECT COUNT(major_id) FROM major WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences' AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'
SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.major_name = 'Education' AND T1.position = 'Member'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PO Box' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(zip_code) FROM zip_code
SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T2.category = 'Parking' AND T2.cost < ( SELECT AVG(cost) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Parking' )
SELECT SUM(T1.spent), T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
SELECT T2.city FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Girke'

SELECT T1.Segment, SUM(IIF(T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS Diff , CAST((SUM(IIF(T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0))) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND T1.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY T1.Segment
SELECT Country, COUNT(Country) FROM gasstations WHERE Segment = 'Value for money' GROUP BY Country
SELECT T1.Segment FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Date = '201309' ORDER BY T2.Consumption ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date LIKE '2012%'
SELECT T1.Description FROM products AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.Currency = 'EUR'
SELECT SUM(T2.Price * T2.Amount) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date LIKE '201201'
